panels.title: Pending approvals
panels.description: Approvals awaiting a decision (decided_at IS NULL or decision = 'pending'). Source: approvals table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending FROM approvals WHERE decided_at IS NULL OR decision = 'pending'
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending FROM approvals WHERE decided_at IS NULL OR decision = 'pending'

panels.title: Poller fires (24h)
panels.description: High-frequency background pollers (resolver_feedback_poll + briefing_drain). Shown as a single health number so they don't drown out scheduled routines. A near-zero value here means the poll loop has stalled.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS poller_fires FROM agent_events WHERE event='routine_started' AND json_extract(detail,'$.routine') IN ('resolver_feedback_poll','briefing_drain') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS poller_fires FROM agent_events WHERE event='routine_started' AND json_extract(detail,'$.routine') IN ('resolver_feedback_poll','briefing_drain') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Approval decisions (14d)
panels.description: Distribution of approval outcomes: approved / denied / rejected / expired / pending. Source: approvals table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(decision='approved') AS approved, SUM(decision='denied') AS denied, SUM(decision='rejected') AS rejected, SUM(decision='expired') AS expired, SUM(decision IS NULL OR decision='pending') AS pending FROM approvals WHERE requested_at >= $__from AND requested_at < $__to
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(decision='approved') AS approved, SUM(decision='denied') AS denied, SUM(decision='rejected') AS rejected, SUM(decision='expired') AS expired, SUM(decision IS NULL OR decision='pending') AS pending FROM approvals WHERE requested_at >= $__from AND requested_at < $__to

panels.title: Scheduled routine fires (24h, pollers excluded)
panels.description: Per-routine firing counts over the last 24h, excluding the two high-frequency pollers (resolver_feedback_poll, briefing_drain) so the real scheduled routines are visible. Source: agent_events routine_started, detail.routine.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT json_extract(detail,'$.routine') AS routine, COUNT(*) AS fires FROM agent_events WHERE event='routine_started' AND json_extract(detail,'$.routine') NOT IN ('resolver_feedback_poll','briefing_drain') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY routine ORDER BY fires DESC LIMIT 25
targets.queryText: SELECT json_extract(detail,'$.routine') AS routine, COUNT(*) AS fires FROM agent_events WHERE event='routine_started' AND json_extract(detail,'$.routine') NOT IN ('resolver_feedback_poll','briefing_drain') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY routine ORDER BY fires DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Approval response latency (approved/denied, per day, 14d)
panels.description: Average human decision latency per day (decided_at - requested_at), restricted to approved/denied so a batch expiry sweep does not corrupt the trend. requested_at/decided_at are epoch milliseconds. Source: approvals table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(requested_at/1000,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, AVG(decided_at - requested_at) AS avg_latency FROM approvals WHERE decision IN ('approved','denied') AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND requested_at >= $__from AND requested_at < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(requested_at/1000,'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, AVG(decided_at - requested_at) AS avg_latency FROM approvals WHERE decision IN ('approved','denied') AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND requested_at >= $__from AND requested_at < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pending approvals (detail)
panels.description: Approval requests still awaiting a decision. requested_at is epoch milliseconds, rendered as UTC datetime. Source: approvals table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT id, kind, summary, risk_tier, datetime(requested_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS requested_at FROM approvals WHERE decided_at IS NULL OR decision = 'pending' ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT id, kind, summary, risk_tier, datetime(requested_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS requested_at FROM approvals WHERE decided_at IS NULL OR decision = 'pending' ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Routing corrections (range)
panels.description: User corrections of a dispatch decision, captured by detectRoutingCorrection (promptPipeline before_prompt). A rising number means Jarvis is routing to the wrong staff. Source: agent_events event='routing_correction'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS corrections FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS corrections FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Routing corrections dropped (range)
panels.description: Routing corrections that failed to persist to the knowledge collection (vec-server down/timeout). Source: agent_events event='routing_correction_dropped'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dropped FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction_dropped' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dropped FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction_dropped' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Routing corrections per day
panels.description: Daily count of user routing corrections. Source: agent_events event='routing_correction'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(*) AS corrections FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(*) AS corrections FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent routing corrections
panels.description: Most recent routing corrections: the staff that was wrongly dispatched (corrected_from) and the user's correction text. Source: agent_events event='routing_correction'.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(ts) AS ts, json_extract(detail,'$.corrected_from') AS corrected_from, json_extract(detail,'$.correction') AS correction FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(ts) AS ts, json_extract(detail,'$.corrected_from') AS corrected_from, json_extract(detail,'$.correction') AS correction FROM agent_events WHERE event='routing_correction' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
